image_description: A side-profile view of a guenon monkey (likely a Diana or similar species) perched on a large, textured rock. The monkey has dark grey/black fur on its back and limbs, with a distinct patch of golden-orange fur on its lower back/rump area, and white/cream fur on its chest and inner thighs. It features a long, non-prehensile tail hanging down. The face is partially visible in profile, showing a dark face with a white brow band. The background consists of a large tree trunk and blurred green foliage.
